second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 14 + Average 3 + Difficulty 2 = 19), pdf 72; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-19 monotonic (II labels printed '04 )'-'09)'), no gaps, no duplicates; 'III.' printed twice (story, match). BLUE PRINT 14/3/2 = 19 = audited count. Answer side: keys 1-3 match; the rest belong to another version. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 19.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 72 (heading, LO 11, BLUE PRINT, situations 1-3 with pictures) 73 (q4-9, story) 74 (q10-19). A side 'Key Answers: 18' pdf 119. Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE: q1-q3 keyed by number. q4-q19 empty + 'key belongs to another paper version' with pointers q4 <- 12, q6 <- 14, q7 <- 15, q8 <- 17, q9 <- 18 (q5: no matching key; key 16 'Panchakshari Gawai' answers no printed question).

Sections: s1 I situations q1-3 (each with its picture stimulus); s2 II q4-9; s3 III story q10-14 (passage stimulus, verbatim English); s4 III (second) match q15-19 (numbered rows -> one-pair match; column B prints 'Classical dancer (Bharatanatyam' with no closing bracket).
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): all four headers match their printed counts -> 1.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 19 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 11, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
PARKED (R-E8; T-E1): empty match q15-q19 cannot pass gate 2.20. Built in the work dir with its crops; not committed.

stimuli.text: One day, I (a boy) saw a blind man trying to cross a busy road. He looked worried and scared. I quickly ran to him and offered my hand. Together we crossed safely. He smiled and thanked me. That day, I realized that small acts of kindness can make a big difference. Helping others not only makes them happy, but it also fills our hearts with joy.
